features.normalisation: per-frame shoulder-centre + shoulder-width; per hand: wrist relative to shoulder centre / shoulder width; other 20 landmarks relative to wrist / hand size (hand_size = ||wrist - middle fingertip||); hand-to-face vectors scaled by shoulder width. Missing runs <=5 frames interpolated; longer/leading/trailing missing kept as zero coordinates with mask=0 and never normalised into shoulder space.

extractor.name: @mediapipe/tasks-vision HolisticExtractor
extractor.note: Same options as the SignSage frontend (frontend/src/features/translate/landmarks.ts): pose numPoses=1, face numFaces=1, hands numHands=2, delegate GPU, no confidence thresholds set (MediaPipe defaults), no delegate fallback. Coordinates are NOT mirrored; only the preview is CSS-mirrored (scaleX(-1)) like the app.

fps_note: Features resampled to 60 frames per clip (uniform subsample if T>=60, edge-pad if T<60). Effective FPS varies per clip (S1 ~5-12 fps, S2 ~5-12 fps); the model is invariant to this because of resampling. Coordinates are NOT mirrored (only the app preview is CSS-mirrored).
threshold_note: Calibrated on the S2 cross-session test (train S1, test S2, cnn-v2, 50 clips, 10 CORE words, no rest). S2 max-softmax threshold table: 0.5 -> acc 0.612 coverage 98.0%; 0.7 -> acc 0.659 coverage 88.0% (recommended operating point); 0.9 -> acc 0.758 coverage 66.0%; argmax -> acc 0.620 coverage 100%. Stated as calibrated on S2 only; not validated on held-out data.

golden_test_vector.note: Run features_v2/sign_features_v2 on golden_test_vector.npy then the model; logits must match expected_logits (within float tolerance).

note: FINAL-UNEVALUATED: trained on S1+S2 combined. S2 was already used as the held-out test set for export_s1, so this model has NO held-out test set. Do not promote without S2-independent validation.
